description: Corrections tools/split-integrations.mjs applies when it splits the vendored catalog into one definition file per key. Each one exists because the catalog and another platform contract disagree; it is removed when the catalog is corrected. requires_feature must name a key of the entitlement document's features object (or be null), so a product can gate an integration on exactly the feature its entitlement carries.

sso.why: the entitlement document names the Ever ID sign-in feature ever_id_login

discoverable.why: the entitlement document names the feature discoverability

profile_public.why: the entitlement document names the feature profile.public

usage.why: the entitlement document names the feature usage_reporting

apps.why: the entitlement document names the feature app_sync

managed.why: the entitlement document carries managed operations as managed.updates and managed.backups, outside the features object
